title: How do I reset a forgotten password
question: How do I reset a forgotten password?
answer: Choose Forgot password, enter your account email, and press Ask for a new password. This requests a new password from support staff; it is not an automatic email reset. Help opens only after you are signed in, so if no new password reaches you, ask an admin of your office's Mirsal.
looks_like: Forgot password has an Ask for a new password button.
